hero.subtitle: We develop modular robotic prosthetics and exoskeletons to enhance autonomy, mobility, and quality of life for individuals.
hero.metric01Desc: ÁPEX bionic hand with adaptive AI control

technology.title: Combining engineering, biology and people
technology.description: We integrate myoelectric sensors, intelligent control, additive manufacturing, and modular design to create biomechanical solutions tailored to every user.
technology.f1Desc: Real-time muscle signal interpretation through high-sensitivity surface contact electrodes.
technology.f2Desc: Adaptive machine-learning algorithms that process motor intention without perceptible latency.
technology.f3Desc: Natural, smooth, and controlled motion powered by brushless micromotors per phalanx.
technology.f4Desc: Full socket customization and simplified maintenance with rapidly interchangeable components.
technology.f5Desc: 3D stump scanning and additive manufacturing using ultralight, biocompatible biomechanical polymers.

products.descHand: An advanced, customizable, and functional prosthetic hand designed to adapt to real-world user needs and perform daily life activities with maximum reliability.
products.descExo: In development: lower-limb exoskeletons engineered for rehabilitation, mobility assistance, and enhanced autonomy during motor recovery.

grips.name: Precision
grips.description: Fine pinch for holding small objects (keys, pens, coins) with millimeter sensitivity.

grips.name: Cylindrical
grips.description: Circumferential grip optimized for glasses, bottles, and tool handles.

grips.name: Pinch
grips.description: Thumb and index finger alignment for quick everyday actions.

grips.name: Spherical
grips.description: Wide multi-directional opening for spheres, fruits, and doorknobs.

grips.name: Lateral
grips.description: Lateral key grip for flat items like credit cards or documents.

grips.name: Neutral
grips.description: Relaxed biomechanical resting state minimizing energy consumption.

about.title: Pro-Stasis
about.desc: We are a technology-based company in the Canary Islands dedicated to the development of bionic prosthetics and exoskeletons. We believe in a future where technology is a direct tool for inclusion, independence, and human well-being.
about.p1Desc: Real-world technology engineered for everyday life.
about.p2Desc: The user is always at the absolute center of design.
about.p3Desc: Positive social impact and maximum component repairability.
about.originTitle: From the Canary Islands to the world
about.originDesc: We develop cutting-edge biomechatronics from the Canary Islands with international vision, collaborating with healthcare centers, European universities, and strategic partners to democratize bionics.
about.teamSubtitle: A multidisciplinary team committed to biomedical innovation, precision engineering, and positive social impact.
about.member1Desc: Objective setting, project planning, and technical development. Production and product prototyping team.
about.member2Desc: Machine programming, head of software development, and higher technician in web application development.
about.member3Desc: Hardware development, electronics manufacturing and schematics, maintenance technician.
about.member4Desc: Web development and sustainability programming, machine design, head of prototyping and industrial design.

collaboration.title: Growing together
collaboration.desc: We partner with robotics companies, research centers, universities, and orthopaedic clinics interested in collaborating on R&D, clinical validation, and next-generation technologies.
collaboration.euTitle: EYE CANARIAS • ERASMUS FOR YOUNG ENTREPRENEURS
collaboration.euFooter: European initiative fostering skills exchange, research collaboration, and internationalization of high-tech startups.

impact.title: Technology for an inclusive society
impact.desc: We build solutions that elevate quality of life, unlock autonomy, and contribute to an accessible, sustainable future.
impact.c1Desc: Enabling a confident return to work and daily activities without biomechanical barriers.
impact.c2Desc: Lowering manufacturing costs via 3D additive manufacturing and standardized components.
impact.c3Desc: Lower carbon footprint and radical waste minimization through modular repairable parts.
impact.c4Desc: Co-creation with physiotherapists, rehabilitation physicians, and patients for clinical efficacy.

roadmap.title: From prototype to reality
roadmap.desc: Our roadmap of technical milestones, medical certifications, and clinical development driven by measurable results.
roadmap.p1Desc: Development of core modular prosthetic hand and kinematic laboratory validation.
roadmap.p2Desc: End-user testing, refined myoelectric sensor integration, and ergonomic optimization.
roadmap.p3Desc: Multi-center clinical trials, CE medical device pre-certification, and haptic feedback.
roadmap.p4Desc: Scalable production, orthopaedic distribution network, and initial adaptive exoskeleton release.

gallery.title: Prototypes and development
gallery.desc: Engineering process snapshots, sensor testing benches, and digital additive manufacturing.
